column1: # The API surface, captured once per principal in scripts/goldens/capture.sh.
# {MEMBER} and {DELETED_MEMBER} are substituted at capture time from the seeded database, so this file survives a
# reseed. "-" in the accept column means no Accept header is sent.
# The versioned endpoints appear twice on purpose: once negotiating correctly, once without an Accept header at all.
# The second case exercises the VersionExpected error path, which is part of the contract other GEWIS systems see and
# is exactly the kind of thing a port silently changes.
